page: Google Cloud Platform g2-standard-8 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine from the GPU Machines family, built for graphics and machine learning inference tasks. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon processor clocked at 2.2 GHz, providing 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The CPU subsystem features 38 MB of L3 cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and vector instruction support including AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI. The system is provisioned with 32.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is delivered by a single bundled NVIDIA Ada Lovelace L4 GPU equipped with 24 GB of VRAM. The configuration includes no local storage and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results demonstrate specialized acceleration profiles paired with moderate CPU performance. CPU-bound synthetic metrics reflect modest capabilities, with single-core Geekbench at 1059.0 and multi-core score at 4017.0, alongside stress-ng results placing single-core performance in the bottom 25 percent and multi-core throughput in the middle 50 percent. Memory bandwidth delivers 50.64 GB/sec for uncached read operations and 37.76 GB/sec for uncached writes. In contrast, the dedicated NVIDIA L4 GPU delivers top-tier throughput for language model inference. Tested benchmarks show prompt processing speeds of 11,784.81 tokens per second on a small 135M model and 2,225.82 tokens per second on a 7B model, alongside text generation rates of 400.83 tokens per second on the 135M model and 52.31 tokens per second on the 7B model.

From an architectural efficiency perspective, the g2-standard-8 concentrates computational resources into hardware acceleration rather than host processor clock speeds. Because local disk storage is not bundled, deployments require external persistent block volumes. This instance type is specifically engineered for workloads such as small-to-medium large language model inference, AI-driven video transcoding, graphics processing, and deep learning model evaluation where GPU acceleration delivers substantial efficiency gains over standard general-purpose compute.
description: Google Cloud Platform g2-standard-8 is a GPU-accelerated instance from the GPU Machines series, engineered for artificial intelligence inference and graphics tasks. It integrates an x86_64 Intel Xeon processor with 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores at 2.2 GHz, supported by 38 MB of L3 cache, alongside 32.0 GB of system RAM. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single bundled NVIDIA Ada Lovelace L4 GPU with 24 GB of VRAM. Local storage is absent, requiring external storage options for persistent data. While host CPU benchmarks remain in average to modest tiers, the NVIDIA L4 delivers top-tier performance for model inference, generating 52.31 tokens per second on 7B parameter models and 2,225.82 tokens per second for prompt processing. The instance is well suited for AI model serving, lightweight deep learning tasks, and GPU-accelerated graphic applications.
